target: UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one vCPU, disposable writable VirtIO disk
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-redsea-stockwrite-current-c161-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-stock-redsea-write
verified: Stock-format RedSea mounted from the disposable VirtIO disk and both seeded files were read correctly.
Regular FileWrite and FileDel removed one file while preserving the later directory entry.
A subsequent write reused the freed allocation without changing the later file.
After a cold QEMU reboot, the new file and preserved file remained readable and the deleted file stayed absent.
The guest returned to a working terminal and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: This validates ordinary RedSea file writes over UTM VirtIO and cold persistence on a disposable guest disk. It does not exercise the Pi SDHCI driver or prove physical microSD writes; Pi psdopen and cold-boot acceptance remain open.
